experiment: Does prewarm(promptPrefix: nil) cut first-call respond latency?
method: fresh process per run, --quick --skip-probes, alternating control/prewarm; prewarm call timed inline
summary: No meaningful delta: control 7059/9630 vs prewarm 6396/9538, well inside run-to-run variance (2717-12203 ms observed same-day for this fixture). The prewarm call itself costs ~12 ms. Verdict: keep the menu-open prewarm hook (free, harmless), claim no latency win; first-call warmth comes from the OS model service, not the app.
